tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. The night-train window in Night, a grey morning in Day.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, rails and quest UI that sit on ground.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Dossier cards, flap-board tiles, menus. One step above surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers only. Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders, route lines, compass ticks. At least 3:1 on ground in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on ground, surface and raised (13:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, datelines, captions on ground, surface and raised (5.7:1 or more).

tokens.name: lantern
tokens.usage: The brand accent: primary actions, the traveller's own marks, selected state, focus. Never on charts.

tokens.name: on-lantern
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a lantern fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid, 3px offset. Meets 3:1 on ground, surface and raised.

tokens.name: warm
tokens.usage: Data: warming, or a rising value of a heat-like variable, when drawn on ground or surface (globe beacons, sparklines).

tokens.name: cool
tokens.usage: Data: cooling, or a falling heat-like value, on ground or surface.

tokens.name: wet
tokens.usage: Data: wetting (rain, humidity, soil water rising) on ground or surface.

tokens.name: dry
tokens.usage: Data: drying on ground or surface. Never beside lantern without a word label.

tokens.name: stamp-detected
tokens.usage: Verdict stamp and text for a detected trend, always with the word Detected and its glyph.

tokens.name: stamp-null
tokens.usage: Verdict for Not detectable yet. Shares the lantern hue on purpose (keep looking); the word and the flat glyph carry the meaning.

tokens.name: stamp-short
tokens.usage: Verdict for Too short to judge, with the hourglass glyph.

tokens.name: plate
tokens.usage: Chart plate (the evidence paper). Identical in both themes so a chart never changes between themes.

tokens.name: plate-ink
tokens.usage: Text, axis labels and data points on plate (14.9:1).

tokens.name: plate-muted
tokens.usage: Tick labels, source lines and captions on plate (6.2:1).

tokens.name: plate-line
tokens.usage: Plate border and gridlines. Decorative.

tokens.name: plate-warm
tokens.usage: Warming series and labels on plate (5.6:1).

tokens.name: plate-cool
tokens.usage: Cooling series and labels on plate (5.1:1).

tokens.name: plate-wet
tokens.usage: Wetting series and labels on plate (5.3:1).

tokens.name: plate-dry
tokens.usage: Drying series and labels on plate (5.1:1).

tokens.name: plate-trend
tokens.usage: The Sen's-slope line on plate: dashed, 2.2px. Direction colour goes on the stamp and labels, not the line.

styles.name: board
styles.usage: Destination names on the flap board and page openers. Uppercase.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Page and dispatch headlines. Sentence case.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Plate titles, dossier names, section heads.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Before you book the ticket, read the weather record.
styles.usage: Opening paragraph of a page or dispatch.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Mann-Kendall compares every pair of years and counts which way they move.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: One grid cell of about 0.5 by 0.625 degrees.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Source: NASA POWER, CERES SYN1deg. Cached 14 Nov 2026.

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: The one headline rate on a dossier. Tabular numerals, explicit sign.

styles.name: field-note
styles.usage: The traveller's handwritten margin note. At most one per screen, never for numbers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap, stamp text offsets.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tag padding, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones, default gap, minimum page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card and plate padding, row gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between related blocks.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between sections on a page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page top and bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Chapter breaks in the scroll story.

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: Luggage tags, badges, flap tiles.

tokens.name: radius-plate
tokens.usage: Chart plates (paper with a soft corner).

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Dossier cards, dispatch clippings, panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Source badges and toggle chips.

tokens.name: shadow-plate
tokens.usage: Chart plates and dossiers: paper lifted off the table.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Hover and drag on tags and lead cards.

tokens.name: dur-quick
tokens.usage: Hover, press, badge changes.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Panel and card transitions.

tokens.name: dur-stamp
tokens.usage: Verdict stamp press, once, never repeated.

tokens.name: dur-flip
tokens.usage: One split-flap character flip.

tokens.name: dur-route
tokens.usage: Route line and series draw-on.

tokens.name: ease-dawn
tokens.usage: Default: arrivals, camera moves, draw-ons.

tokens.name: ease-press
tokens.usage: Stamp press only: one small overshoot.

tokens.name: ease-steady
tokens.usage: Playheads tied to audio time.
